effect_description_eng:
[Trash] [Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolves into [Barbamon (X Antibody)], by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's level 7 or lower Digimon. For every 3 cards in your opponent's hand, remove 1 from this effect level maximum.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
